summary: Section A of the 2026 TICO Texas Statistical Plan establishes general residential-property statistical reporting rules, including scope, direct-business reporting, premium/loss/claim reporting conventions, monthly report due dates, TICO designation, transmittal requirements, and special rules for TWIA depopulation, private flood, replacement-cost indicators, and cancellation/nonrenewal/declination reporting. The document requires monthly submissions within 45 days after month close and adds April 1, 2026 applicability for CND notice and actual-count reporting.

proposed_nodes.name: TICO Texas Statistical Plan for Residential Risks — Section A: General Rules
proposed_nodes.title: TICO Texas Statistical Plan for Residential Risks (eff. 2026-01-01), Section A: General Rules

proposed_nodes.name: THSP_2026
proposed_nodes.notes: Edition inferred from the title's 2026 effective date.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.1 — Scope of the Plan
proposed_nodes.title: Scope of the Plan
proposed_nodes.notes: Applies to reports required to be filed with TDI for reporting periods beginning on or after April 1, 2026; earlier reports remain governed by the prior applicable plan.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.2 — Methods of Recording and Compiling Experience
proposed_nodes.title: Methods of Recording and Compiling Experience
proposed_nodes.notes: Plan is designed to develop experience on a calendar/accident year basis.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.3 — Recording of Experience
proposed_nodes.title: Recording of Experience
proposed_nodes.notes: Carriers may use internal procedures and codes if they can report required experience data timely and in accordance with the Plan.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.4 — Uniform Method of Reporting Experience
proposed_nodes.title: Uniform Method of Reporting Experience
proposed_nodes.notes: Carriers must report experience according to TDI instructions and Plan codes, and attest to accuracy and completeness.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.5 — Reinsurance
proposed_nodes.title: Reinsurance
proposed_nodes.notes: Except as provided in Rule 31, experience is reported on direct business only, excluding assumed reinsurance and without ceded-reinsurance deductions.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.6 — Amounts of Insurance—Premiums and Losses
proposed_nodes.title: Amounts of Insurance—Premiums and Losses
proposed_nodes.notes: Requires limits of liability on premium and loss records, recorded in thousands; specifies coverage components for homeowners, dwelling, tenant, and condominium forms.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.7 — Premiums
proposed_nodes.title: Premiums
proposed_nodes.notes: Direct-business premiums must be identified by Record Type Codes and other Section B statistical codes; certain additional coverages and company enhancement endorsements receive specified reporting treatment.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.8 — Effective and Expiration Dates—Premiums
proposed_nodes.title: Effective and Expiration Dates—Premiums
proposed_nodes.notes: Specifies effective and expiration date reporting for premium records, including cancellation records.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.9 — Cancellations—Premiums
proposed_nodes.title: Cancellations—Premiums
proposed_nodes.notes: Specifies coding treatment for flat and pro rata cancellation premium entries.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.10 — Changes by Endorsement
proposed_nodes.title: Changes by Endorsement
proposed_nodes.notes: Specifies reversal and corrected-entry handling for endorsements changing coding conditions or premium amount at inception/renewal, and Record Type handling after inception.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.11 — Losses Exclusive of Loss Adjustment Expense
proposed_nodes.title: Losses Exclusive of Loss Adjustment Expense
proposed_nodes.notes: Losses are reported net of salvage, subrogation, and other recoveries other than reinsurance; loss adjustment expenses are not reported.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.12 — Negative Amounts
proposed_nodes.title: Negative Amounts
proposed_nodes.notes: Defines units-position overpunch symbols for negative amounts and gives an example for a negative fire premium transaction.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.13 — New Claim Count
proposed_nodes.title: New Claim Count
proposed_nodes.notes: Specifies when and how new claims, previously reported claims, reversals, and multiple statistical entries are reported using New Claim Count.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.14 — Paid Claim Count
proposed_nodes.title: Paid Claim Count
proposed_nodes.notes: Specifies Paid Claim Count treatment for first payment, nonpayment, later payments, reversals, recoveries, and separately coded statistical entries.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.15 — Reopened Claim Count
proposed_nodes.title: Reopened Claim Count
proposed_nodes.notes: Specifies when closed claims must or may be reported again, defines newly reopened claims, and sets Reopened Claim Count reporting and reversal treatment.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.16 — Claim Status
proposed_nodes.title: Claim Status
proposed_nodes.notes: Specifies end-of-month claim status reporting for new, open, changed, previously closed, open, and closed claims with or without indemnity payment.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.17 — Adjustments—Premiums and Losses
proposed_nodes.title: Adjustments—Premiums and Losses
proposed_nodes.notes: Requires correction of original coding errors by reversing the original entry and making a corrected entry; reversal amounts of insurance are coded as negative offsets.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.18 — Geographical Divisions
proposed_nodes.title: Geographical Divisions
proposed_nodes.notes: State, city, and town codes must be recorded for homeowners and dwelling policies; current Texas Place Codes are obtained from TDI's Residential Property statistical agent.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.19 — Deductible Insurance
proposed_nodes.title: Deductible Insurance
proposed_nodes.notes: Each premium and loss entry must identify deductible type or amount codes and include actual deductible dollar amounts.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.20 — Prior Claims History
proposed_nodes.title: Prior Claims History
proposed_nodes.notes: Insurers using prior claims history as rating or tiering variable must report prior-five-year chargeable claim counts, subject to exclusions under Texas law and regulation.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.21 — Experience to Be Reported
proposed_nodes.title: Experience to Be Reported
proposed_nodes.notes: Requires monthly submission of premium/exposure/loss unit transactions, CND reasons, and actual CND counts within 45 days after month close, plus annual reconciliation.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.22 — Company Number
proposed_nodes.title: Company Number
proposed_nodes.notes: Each reporting carrier must identify records by the Company Number assigned by TICO.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.23 — Accounting Date—Premium and Losses
proposed_nodes.title: Accounting Date—Premium and Losses
proposed_nodes.notes: The month and year in which a transaction was recorded on the carrier's books must be shown.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.24 — ZIP Code
proposed_nodes.title: ZIP Code
proposed_nodes.notes: Five-digit ZIP code is required for each risk; ZIP+4 is reported for premium and loss records if available.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.25 — NAIC Company Number
proposed_nodes.title: NAIC Company Number
proposed_nodes.notes: NAIC company number must be entered for all records.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.26 — Policy Identifier
proposed_nodes.title: Policy Identifier
proposed_nodes.notes: Defines policy identifier as company-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the policy in premium or loss records and consistently reused for the same policy.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.27 — Claim Identifier
proposed_nodes.title: Claim Identifier
proposed_nodes.notes: Defines claim identifier as two-character company-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying, with policy identifier and occurrence date, a claim in loss records.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.28 — Designated Statistical Agent
proposed_nodes.title: Designated Statistical Agent
proposed_nodes.notes: Commissioner designated TICO as TDI's statistical agent for Texas residential property insurance; companies report experience to TICO for transactions on or after January 1, 1996.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.29 — Transmittal Form
proposed_nodes.title: Transmittal Form
proposed_nodes.notes: A residential property data submission transmittal form must accompany all data submitted to TICO and include company, NAIC, record counts, significant-field totals, medium, and format information.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.30 — Tenure Discounts
proposed_nodes.title: Tenure Discounts
proposed_nodes.notes: Insurers using tenure for rating or tiering must report a Tenure Code for premium and loss transactions; insurers offering tenure discounts must report the percentage discount code.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.31 — Reporting for TWIA Depopulation
proposed_nodes.title: Reporting for TWIA Depopulation
proposed_nodes.notes: Specifies reporting responsibilities and transaction treatment for TWIA depopulation policies subject to assumption reinsurance, including wind-only line-of-business codes and special transaction codes.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.32 — Private Flood Coverage Indicator
proposed_nodes.title: Private Flood Coverage Indicator
proposed_nodes.notes: Requires private flood coverage indicator reporting for specified residential policies; excludes NFIP Write Your Own and stand-alone excess flood policies; primary stand-alone private flood uses line of business code 35.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.33 — Replacement Cost Building, Replacement Cost Contents, and Roof Coverage Type
proposed_nodes.title: Replacement Cost Building, Replacement Cost Contents, and Roof Coverage Type
proposed_nodes.notes: Requires reporting whether dwelling, personal property, and roof coverage are replacement cost or ACV, including endorsement impacts and functional replacement cost treatment.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.34 — Reporting Reason Codes for Cancellation, Nonrenewal, and Declination Notices
proposed_nodes.title: Reporting Reason Codes for Cancellation, Nonrenewal, and Declination Notices
proposed_nodes.notes: Requires monthly reporting of reasons and notified policy counts for CND notices under Insurance Code Chapter 551, including applicability, due dates, concatenation, and cancellation/declination treatment.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule A.35 — Reporting Actual Cancellations, Nonrenewals, and Declinations
proposed_nodes.title: Reporting Actual Cancellations, Nonrenewals, and Declinations
proposed_nodes.notes: Requires monthly ZIP-code summaries of actual cancellations, nonrenewals, and declinations, with counts reconciling to NAIC MCAS for cancellations and nonrenewals.

proposed_nodes.name: Dwelling, HO Premiums Report
proposed_nodes.notes: Monthly report of premium and exposure unit transactions.

proposed_nodes.name: Dwelling, HO Losses Report
proposed_nodes.notes: Monthly report of paid and outstanding loss unit transactions.

proposed_nodes.name: Dwelling, HO Cancellation, Nonrenewal, and Declination Notices Report
proposed_nodes.report_name: Dwelling, HO Cancellation, Nonrenewal, and Declination Notices
proposed_nodes.notes: Monthly report of reasons and notified policy counts for CND notices; first April 2026 report due June 15, 2026.

proposed_nodes.name: Dwelling, HO Number of Actual Cancellations, Nonrenewals, and Declinations Report
proposed_nodes.report_name: Dwelling, HO Number of Actual Cancellations, Nonrenewals, and Declinations
proposed_nodes.notes: Monthly report of actual cancellation, nonrenewal, and declination counts by ZIP code; first April 2026 report due June 15, 2026.

proposed_nodes.name: Residential Property Data Submission Transmittal Form
proposed_nodes.report_name: Residential Property Data Submission Transmittal Form
proposed_nodes.notes: Must accompany all data submitted to TICO; cadence inferred from monthly submissions it accompanies.

proposed_nodes.name: Annual Reconciliation Submission
proposed_nodes.notes: Reporting carriers must submit a reconciliation once a year to TDI's designated statistical agent.

proposed_nodes.name: Annual Reconciliation to TDI Designated Statistical Agent
Actual CND Counts Reconcile to NAIC MCAS
proposed_nodes.against_target: NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement (MCAS) cancellations and nonrenewals counts

proposed_nodes.name: Texas Insurance Checking Office
proposed_nodes.notes: Named in the Plan as TICO, TDI's statistical agent for Texas residential property insurance.

proposed_nodes.name: Texas Windstorm Insurance Association
proposed_nodes.notes: Organization kind mapped to Insurer for closed vocabulary purposes.

proposed_nodes.name: National Association of Insurance Commissioners
proposed_nodes.notes: Referenced through NAIC company number and NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement; organization kind mapped to Regulator for closed vocabulary purposes.

proposed_nodes.name: Dwelling Coverage
proposed_nodes.notes: Amount of insurance must be recorded for dwelling coverage on homeowners/dwelling forms and condominium forms, with condominium alterations/appliances/fixtures/improvements included where applicable.

proposed_nodes.name: Personal Property Coverage
proposed_nodes.notes: Amount of insurance must be recorded for personal property; for tenant forms, personal property only is reported.

proposed_nodes.name: Loss of Use / Additional Living Expense Coverage
proposed_nodes.notes: For percentage-of-Coverage-A loss-of-use limits, carriers convert to a dollar amount; if both a time limit and dollar limit apply, only the dollar limit is reported.
proposed_nodes.coverage_name: Loss of Use / Additional Living Expense

proposed_nodes.name: Private Flood Coverage
proposed_nodes.notes: Includes coverage for flood or rising waters in policy or endorsement; excludes NFIP Write Your Own and stand-alone private residential excess flood policies.

proposed_nodes.name: Replacement Cost Building Coverage Type
proposed_nodes.notes: Report whether main dwelling coverage, including endorsements, is on replacement cost or ACV basis; functional replacement cost is reported as replacement cost.

proposed_nodes.name: Replacement Cost Contents Coverage Type
proposed_nodes.notes: Report whether personal property coverage, including endorsements, is on replacement cost or ACV basis; functional replacement cost is reported as replacement cost.

proposed_nodes.name: Roof Coverage Type
proposed_nodes.notes: Report roof coverage as replacement cost or ACV, including endorsement impacts; declining schedules based on age are reported as ACV.
